results.title: Applying Model-Based Systems Engineering on CubeSat Budget Calculating
results.abstract: This work presents a tool based on Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) for automating the process of budget calculation - mass, volume, power, and energy - for CubeSat nanosatellites based on user input which can be iteratively fine-tuned to fit the CubeSat limitations. results.title: Open-source CubeSat MBSE Approach to Address Traceability: Power Subsystem
results.abstract: The benefits of using Model-based System Engineering (MBSE) approaches for the development of projects go beyond just replacing document-centric methods. MBSE is expected to aid in the ability to manage complexity and capture knowledge.
